# nja

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/fwimp/njar/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/fwimp/njar/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

`njar` is an R port of the [NJA python package](https://github.com/fwimp/NJA) for fitting graphs to images of spatial networks.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `njar` like so:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("fwimp/njar")
```
